logo.direction: Wordmark 'Vetrix' in Poppins 600 with a simple original glyph: a rounded paw print whose centre pad carries a small heartbeat line. Teal on white, white on teal. No stethoscope, no cross, no cartoon animals.
logo.clinic_logo_slot: Clinic uploads its own logo in onboarding step 1. Clinic logo appears on client-facing messages and the booking page. Vetrix branding appears in the staff app only.

species_icons.style: 2px line icons, rounded caps, 24px grid, original artwork

avoid: upsell language on sick or end-of-life calls
